description_en: Moderates image and text content and synchronously returns the moderation results
description_zh: 进行图片、文本内容审核，审核结果同步返回
name: ImAudit

parameters.help_en:
The JSON array of image URLs. By default, a maximum of 5 images are processed. You can obtain the URLs from the MPS console > Media management > Media list. You must specify at least one image or text. The image files to be moderated must meet the following limits. Otherwise, the job may fail:

The image size does not exceed 20 MB, the height or width does not exceed 30,000 pixels, and the total number of pixels does not exceed 250 million.

(Recommended) The image resolution is no less than 256 × 256 pixels. A low resolution may affect the moderation results
parameters.help_zh:
图片URL的JSON数组，默认最多处理5张。可以通过MPS控制台 > 媒体管理 > 媒体列表获取。图片和文本至少填写一个。待审核图片文件需要符合下述限制，否则可能导致任务失败：

图片大小不超过20 MB，高度或宽度不超过30000px，且图片总像素不超过2.5亿px。

（建议）图片像素不低于256×256px，像素过低可能会影响审核效果
parameters.name: images

parameters.help_en: The JSON array of text content. This is a user-defined array. By default, a maximum of 5 text segments are processed, and each text segment can contain up to 10,000 characters, including punctuation marks. You must specify at least one image or text
parameters.help_zh: 文本JSON数组，用户自定义数组，默认最多处理5段文本，每段文本最长10,000个字符（包含标点）。图片和文本至少填写一个
parameters.name: contents

parameters.help_en:
The scenarios used for moderation. You can specify multiple scenarios and separate them with commas (,). For example, {"porn","terrorism"} indicates that the images are moderated for both pornographic content and terrorist and political content. Valid values:

porn: intelligent detection of pornographic content in images

terrorism: detection of terrorist and political content in images

ad: detection of advertising violations in images and text

qrcode: detection of QR codes in images

live: detection of undesirable scenes in images

logo: detection of logos in images

antispam: text anti-spam (applies only to text)
parameters.help_zh:
场景说明，用于指定审核场景。支持指定多个场景，用半角逗号（,）分隔。例如，{"porn","terrorism"}表示对图片同时进行智能鉴黄和暴恐涉政检测。取值：

porn：图片智能鉴黄。

terrorism：图片暴恐涉政。

ad：图文违规。

qrcode：图片二维码。

live：图片不良场景。

logo：图片logo。

antispam：文本反垃圾（仅对文本生效）
parameters.name: scenes

ImageQuotaExceed.description_en:
Indicates whether the queries per second (QPS) limit for image moderation is exceeded. Valid values:
true: The limit is exceeded.
false: The limit is not exceeded.
The default QPS limit for image moderation is 5
ImageQuotaExceed.description_zh: 图片审核QPS是否超过限制。取值：true（超过）、false（不超过）。默认图片审核QPS是5

ImageResults.description_en: The image moderation results. If the call is successful (code=200), the results contain one or more elements. For more information about the parameters, see [Response data of the image and text moderation API]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/268644.html）
ImageResults.description_zh: 图片审核返回结果。调用成功是（code=200），返回结果中包含一个或多个元素。参数详情请参见[图文审核接口返回数据]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/268644.html）

items.description_zh: 图片审核结果详细信息

code.description_en: The error code, which is the same as the HTTP status code. This parameter is not returned if the operation is successful
code.description_zh: 错误码，和HTTP状态码一致。如果执行成功则此参数不返回

dataId.description_en:
The data ID of the moderated object.

If the dataId request parameter is specified, the corresponding data ID is returned here
dataId.description_zh:
检测对象对应的数据ID。

如果在检测请求参数中传入了dataId，则此处返回对应的dataId

extras.description_en:
The additional information. In the image and text violation (ad) scenario, this parameter may return the following content:
hitLibInfo: the information about the custom text library that is hit by the text in the image. The value is an array. For more information about the structure, see [hitLibInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/268644.html）
extras.description_zh:
额外附加信息。图文违规（ad）场景中，该参数可能返回以下内容。
hitLibInfo：如果图片中的文字命中了自定义文本库，则返回命中的文本库信息。格式为数组，更多结构描述请参见[hitLibInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/268644.html）

msg.description_en: The response message of the request

results.description_en: The returned results. If the call is successful, the results contain one or more elements. Each element is a struct
results.description_zh: 返回结果。调用成功时，返回结果中包含一个或多个元素。每个元素是一个结构体

Label.description_en:
The category of the moderation result. The categories vary based on the moderation scenario. Details:

Categories for intelligent pornography detection (porn) in images:

    - normal: normal.

    - sexy: sexy.

    - porn: pornographic.

Categories for terrorism and political content (terrorism) in images:

    - normal: normal.

    - bloody: bloody.

    - explosion: explosion and smoke.

    - outfit: special outfit.

    - logo: special logo.

    - weapon: weapon.

    - politics: political content.

    - violence: violence.
    
    - crowd: crowd.

    - parade: parade.

    - carcrash: car crash.

    - flag: flag.

    - location: landmark.

    - others: others.

Categories for image and text violations (ad):

    - normal: normal.

    - ad: other advertisements.

    - politics: political content in text.

    - porn: pornographic content in text.

    - abuse: abusive content in text.

    - terrorism: terrorism content in text.

    - contraband: contraband content in text.

    - spam: other spam content in text.

    - npx: nuisance advertisement.

    - qrcode: QR code.

    - programCode: mini program code.

Categories for QR codes (qrcode) in images:

    - normal: normal.

    - qrcode: QR code.

    - programCode: mini program code.

Categories for undesirable scenes (live) in images:

    - normal: normal.

    - meaningless: no content in the image, such as a black or white screen.

    - PIP: picture-in-picture.

    - smoking: smoking.

    - drivelive: in-car live streaming.

Categories for logos (logo) in images:

    - normal: normal.

    - TV: controlled logo.

    - trademark: trademark
Label.description_zh:
检测结果的分类。不同检测场景的结果分类不同，具体如下：

图片智能鉴黄（porn）结果分类：

    - normal：正常。

    - sexy：性感。

    - porn：色情。

图片暴恐涉政（terrorism）结果分类：

    - normal：正常。

    - bloody：血腥。

    - explosion：爆炸烟光。

    - outfit：特殊装束。

    - logo：特殊标识。

    - weapon：武器。

    - politics：涉政。

    - violence：打斗。
    
    - crowd：聚众。

    - parade：游行。

    - carcrash：车祸现场。

    - flag：旗帜。

    - location：地标。

    - others：其他。

图文违规（ad）结果分类：

    - normal：正常。

    - ad：其他广告。

    - politics：文字含涉政内容。

    - porn：文字含涉黄内容。

    - abuse：文字含辱骂内容。

    - terrorism：文字含暴恐内容。

    - contraband：文字含违禁内容。

    - spam：文字含其他垃圾内容。

    - npx：牛皮癣广告。

    - qrcode：含二维码。

    - programCode：含小程序码。

图片二维码（qrcode）结果分类：

    - normal：正常。

    - qrcode：含二维码。

    - programCode：含小程序码。

图片不良场景（live）结果分类：

    - normal：正常。

    - meaningless：图片中无内容（例如，黑屏、白屏）。

    - PIP：画中画。

    - smoking：吸烟。

    - drivelive：车内直播。

图片logo（logo）结果分类：

    - normal：正常。

    - TV：含受管控的logo。

    - trademark：含商标

Rate.description_en:
The confidence level score. Valid values: 0 to 100. A value of 0 indicates the lowest confidence level, and a value of 100 indicates the highest confidence level. If the suggestion parameter is set to pass, a higher confidence level indicates a higher probability that the content is normal. If the suggestion parameter is set to review or block, a lower confidence level indicates a higher probability of a content violation.

This value is for reference only. Do not use it in your business logic. Use the suggestion and label parameters (or the sublabel parameter returned by some operations) to determine content violations
Rate.description_zh:
置信度分数，取值范围：0（表示置信度最低）~100（表示置信度最高）。如果suggestion为pass，则置信度越高，表示内容正常的可能性越高；如果suggestion为review或block，则置信度越低，表示内容违规的可能性越高。

该值仅作为参考，强烈建议您不要在业务中使用。建议您参考suggestion和label（或者部分接口返回的sublabel）结果用于内容违规判定

Scene.description_en:
The image moderation scenario. Valid values:

porn: intelligent pornography detection in images.

terrorism: terrorism and political content detection in images.

ad: image and text violation detection.

qrcode: QR code detection in images.

live: undesirable scene detection in images.

logo: logo detection in images
Scene.description_zh:
图片检测场景。可取值：

porn：图片智能鉴黄。

terrorism：图片暴恐涉政。

ad：图文违规。

qrcode：图片二维码。

live：图片不良场景。

logo：图片logo

Suggestion.description_en:
The recommended action to execute for What to do next. Valid values:

pass: The content is normal, and no further action is required.

review: The result is uncertain, and manual review is required.

block: The content violates regulations. Delete the content or restrict its public access
Suggestion.description_zh:
建议您执行的后续操作。可取值：

pass：结果正常，无需进行其余操作。

review：结果不确定，需要进行人工审核。

block：结果违规，建议直接删除或者限制公开

frames.description_en: The temporary access URLs of each frame image after truncation. This parameter is returned if the image to be moderated is truncated because it is too long
frames.description_zh: 如果待检测图片因为过长被截断，该参数返回截断后的每一帧图像的临时访问地址

rate.description_en: The confidence score. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher confidence score indicates a higher credibility of the moderation result. Do not use this score in your business logic
rate.description_zh: 置信度分数，取值范围：0~100，置信度越高表示检测结果的可信度越高。建议您不要在业务中使用该分数

url.description_en: The temporary access URL of the truncated image. The URL is valid for 5 minutes
url.description_zh: 被截断的图片的临时访问URL，地址有效期是5分钟

hintWordsInfo.description_en: The information about the risk keywords hit by the advertisement text in the image. This parameter is returned when the image contains advertisements or text violations
hintWordsInfo.description_zh: 图片中含有广告或文字违规信息时，返回图片中广告文字命中的风险关键词信息

context.description_en: The content of the risk keyword hit by the text
context.description_zh: 文字命中的风险关键词内容

logoData.description_en: The recognized logo information. This parameter is returned when the image contains a logo
logoData.description_zh: 图片中含有logo时，返回识别出来的logo信息

h.description_en: The height of the logo area. Unit: pixels

name.description_en: The name of the recognized logo

type.description_en: The type of the recognized logo. Valid values: TV (TV station logo)
type.description_zh: 识别出的logo类型，取值为TV （台标）

w.description_en: The width of the logo area. Unit: pixels

x.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the logo area to the y-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin. Unit: pixels
x.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，logo区域左上角到y轴距离，单位：像素

y.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the logo area to the x-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin. Unit: pixels
y.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，logo区域左上角到x轴距离，单位：像素

items.description_en: The complete text information recognized in the image
items.description_zh: 识别到的图片中的完整文字信息

programCodeData.description_en: The location information of the mini program code. This parameter is returned when the image contains a mini program code
programCodeData.description_zh: 图片中含有小程序码时，返回小程序码的位置信息

items.description_en: The list of mini program codes

h.description_en: The height of the mini program code area. Unit: pixels
h.description_zh: 小程序码区域高度，单位：像素

w.description_en: The width of the mini program code area. Unit: pixels
w.description_zh: 小程序码区域宽度，单位：像素

x.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the mini program code area to the y-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin. Unit: pixels
x.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，小程序码区域左上角到y轴距离，单位：像素

y.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the mini program code area to the x-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin. Unit: pixels
y.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，小程序码区域左上角到x轴距离，单位：像素

qrcodeData.description_en: The text information contained in all QR codes in the image. This parameter is returned when the image contains QR codes
qrcodeData.description_zh: 图片中含有二维码时，返回图片中所有二维码包含的文本信息

items.description_en: The text information contained in the QR code
items.description_zh: 二维码包含的文本信息

qrcodeLocations.description_en: The coordinate information of the QR codes recognized in the image
qrcodeLocations.description_zh: 返回图片中识别到的二维码的坐标信息

h.description_en: The height of the QR code area. Unit: pixels
h.description_zh: 二维码区域高度，单位：像素

w.description_en: The width of the QR code area. Unit: pixels
w.description_zh: 二维码区域宽度，单位：像素

x.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the QR code area to the y-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin. Unit: pixels
x.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，二维码区域左上角到y轴距离，单位：像素

y.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the QR code area to the x-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin. Unit: pixels
y.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，二维码区域左上角到x轴距离，单位：像素

sfaceData.description_en: The recognized terrorism and political content information. This parameter is returned when the image contains terrorism or political content
sfaceData.description_zh: 图片中包含暴恐识涉政内容时，返回识别出来的暴恐涉政信息

items.description_en: The list of terrorism and political content information

idid.description_en: The face ID. The value is a string

name.description_zh: 字符串类型，相似人物的名称

re.description_en: The confidence score. The value is a floating-point number. Valid values: 0 to 100. A value of 0 indicates the lowest confidence, and a value of 100 indicates the highest confidence. A higher confidence score indicates a higher credibility of the face recognition result
re.description_zh: 浮点数类型，置信度分数，取值范围：0（表示置信度最低）~100（表示置信度最高）。置信度越高表示人物识别结果的可信度越高

x.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the face area to the y-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin. Unit: pixels
x.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，人脸区域左上角到y轴距离，单位：像素

y.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the face area to the y-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin. Unit: pixels
y.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，人脸区域左上角到y轴距离，单位：像素

taskId.description_en: The ID of the moderation task

url.description_en: The URL of the moderated object

Indicates whether the queries per second (QPS) limit for text moderation is exceeded. Valid values:

The default QPS limit for text moderation is 5
TextQuotaExceed.description_zh: 文本审核QPS是否超过限制，取值：true（超过）、false（不超过）。默认文本审核的QPS是5

TextResults.description_zh: 文本审核返回结果。调用成功是（code=200），返回结果中包含一个或多个元素。参数详情请参见[图文审核接口返回数据]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/268644.html）

rate.description_en:
The confidence level score. Valid values: 0 to 100. A value of 0 indicates the lowest confidence level, and a value of 100 indicates the highest confidence level. If suggestion is pass, a higher confidence level indicates a higher probability that the content is normal. If suggestion is review or block, a lower confidence level indicates a higher probability of a content violation.

This value is for reference only. Do not use it in your business logic. Refer to the suggestion and label results, or the sublabel results returned by some operations, to determine whether a content violation exists
rate.description_zh:
置信度分数，取值范围：0（表示置信度最低）~100（表示置信度最高）。如果suggestion为pass，则置信度越高，表示内容正常的可能性越高；如果suggestion为review或block，则置信度越低，表示内容违规的可能性越高。

该值仅作为参考，强烈建议您不要在业务中使用。建议您参考suggestion和label（或者部分接口返回的sublabel）结果用于内容违规判定

suggestion.description_en:
The recommended action to execute. This indicates What to do next. Valid values:

pass: The text is normal and can be directly allowed.

review: The text requires further manual review.

block: The text contains a content violation and can be directly deleted or restricted from public view
suggestion.description_zh:

pass：文本正常，可以直接放行。

review：文本需要进一步人工审核。

block：文本违规，可以直接删除或者限制公开

taskId.description_en: The ID of the moderation task
